text:
Which statement is not a method for magnetising an iron bar?
A
Place the bar next to a magnet and hammer the bar.
B
Place the bar inside a solenoid. Switch on an alternating current (a.c.) in the coil and
gradually reduce the current.
C
Place the bar inside a solenoid. Switch on a direct current (d.c.) in the coil and gradually
reduce the current.
D
Stroke the bar repeatedly with a magnet.
